orbital-terminal.strengths: Bright suspended Play decks, rear X-trusses and machinery, connected distant dock/hull silhouettes, and a generous lower flight void remain legible in both platforms.
orbital-terminal.owner_judgment: The composition deliberately remains open and restrained; the small Overview actor is primarily found by its PILOT label. Closer zoom is needed to judge piloting and rear depth.

neon-rain-arcology.strengths: Uneven bright physical roofs and platforms sit in front of darker inhabited blocks and stepped far towers; several large internal gaps remain open.
neon-rain-arcology.owner_judgment: Diagonal native facade texture is present with atmosphere OFF. ON adds sparse rain in voids and restrained low haze; do not describe the facade texture itself as native or physically simulated rain.

industrial-underworks.strengths: The large static native turbine, pressure columns and rear cabinets give the environment a distinct industrial hierarchy behind bright service decks.
industrial-underworks.owner_judgment: The orange lower truss resembles a bridge but is decorative. The turbine geometry is static; this image does not demonstrate a rotating physical machine.

abyss-foundry.strengths: Connected irregular rock surrounds a large central void, with readable mineral edges and bright physical decks. Darker rear rock remains visible through openings.
abyss-foundry.owner_judgment: The central orange gantry disappears in the inspected isolated Play capture; it is decorative. The right-side orange pipe remains on Play, so colour alone is not a collision rule.

vertical-transfer-spine.strengths: Rear carriage cages, continuous cables/pulley, repeated trusses and alternating bright physical landings create a tall industrial rhythm.
vertical-transfer-spine.owner_judgment: Rear cross-trusses resemble barriers but do not define Play collision. Fit-to-world reduces the actor and material grid; inspect closer before judging route readability.

owner_gallery_selection.title: Orbital fabrication terminal
owner_gallery_selection.caption: Actual full native stack; open flight corridor and distinct rear machinery. Overview is for composition inspection.

owner_gallery_selection.title: Organic / industrial abyss
owner_gallery_selection.caption: Actual full native stack; the central orange gantry is decorative. Compare Solo Play for collision ownership.

owner_gallery_selection.title: Explicit masked native import
owner_gallery_selection.caption: Actual ordinary Workbench Ready controls. The RGB source uses an explicit authored mask; the coloured proposal encodes material IDs.

owner_gallery_selection.title: Layered composition review
owner_gallery_selection.caption: Actual selected-stage Before/After and fixed-order, current-opacity native-ID composite. Appearance settings require separate approval after native construction.

owner_gallery_selection.title: Arcology atmosphere OFF
owner_gallery_selection.caption: Actual matched native scene/camera before enabling decorative atmosphere; diagonal facade texture is already native geometry presentation.

owner_gallery_selection.title: Arcology atmosphere ON
owner_gallery_selection.caption: Actual matching scene with presentation-only sparse rain and haze. Native material hashes remain unchanged; this still does not qualify motion quality or GPU FPS.

native_grid_scope: Unresampled actual framebuffer crops with measured pixels/native cell within 1% of unity; not mathematical 1:1 and not a guarantee of the viewer/browser display scale.
atmosphere_scope: Original actual framebuffer samples, frozen/restored borrowed Play palette and emission clocks, equal four-plane native material hashes, no recurring decorative native capture delta, recorded paused/hidden phase equality. Stills are not a physical lighting, material simulation, motion-quality or FPS witness.
import_scope: Both reference crops are RGB and fully opaque. Explicit B-authored binary masks and deterministic reviewed palettes produce native requests; original image pixels do not confer authoritative depth. Ready thumbnails encode native IDs, not material-surface appearance. Native apply/Undo is supported by original full-region hashes, not inferred from the thumbnail.
compose_scope: The inspected graphical Compose case was reviewed then stopped without approval. It proves visible proposal/approval controls and zero-write cancellation, not graphical execution of the full construction plan. Separate native workflow evidence covers acknowledged construction.
limitations: No complete route traversal or high-speed playability inferred from initial actor progression or still images.
No physical Windows 11/NVIDIA appearance, motion, input or performance acceptance.
No new native decorative simulation, physical light transport or cross-plane transfer.
No original-source-1/2/3 failure reclassified as a passing execution; source3 produced no evaluator.
Only the exact selected images listed here were directly viewed by B in this final review. Other counters are attributed to original qualifier receipts.
